g.text: Node budget at four prescribed error tolerances
Same tolerance: farther left means fewer knots. Means include finite tolerance misses; consult the paired pass-rate panel.
64-knot cap; common insertion + pruning for all six methods. Dual bounds: MSE <= epsilon and MaxSE <= 10 epsilon.
